66.literal: I'll teach you how those of us dyed "black" do things...
66.official: I'll show ya how we do things in the shadows.

67.literal: It's a storeroom that even Odyssey hardly ever uses.

68.literal: But asking me to lend you a room so you can lock a woman up,
68.official: Still, askin' me to lend you space to keep a girl locked up?

69.literal: Heh, you're a bold man... Something like that,

70.literal: ...If certain people got wind of this,
70.official: If the wrong guys knew about this, I couldn't stick around.

71.literal: The two clubs, the Grand and Odyssey, competing with each other
71.official: Sotenbori is what it is because the Grand and Odyssey are lockin' horns.

72.literal: It's just like baseball. A league with only one strong team won't draw any fans.
72.official: Just like baseball. Nobody watches a series where one team steamrolls the rest.

73.literal: The game won't get anybody excited with just Odyssey in it, will it?
73.official: You think Odyssey has what it takes to keep a one-sided game interesting?

74.literal: Fine. That secret hobby of yours,
74.official: Very well. I'll keep your private indulgences to myself for now.

75.literal: I'll keep it tucked away in my chest.
75.official: Very well. I'll keep your private indulgences to myself for now.

76.literal: Right. They bill you by the hour like a cabaret,
76.official: Right. They charge by the hour like a cabaret,

77.literal: Even if your finances are tight, you've got that much money, don't you?
77.official: I know business ain't great over at Odyssey, but you gotta have that much lyin' around.

78.literal: "He who rules the cabaret clubs rules the night town..."
78.official: Whoever rules the cabaret clubs rules the night...

79.literal: ...It was "Jambalaya" in Shofukucho West, wasn't it?
79.official: (Place was called Jambalaya, a mahjong parlor in Shofukucho West.)

80.literal: ...He was a strange one, that guy called Lee.
80.official: (Whoever that Lee guy is, he's a piece of work...)

81.literal: Well, food comes first, I guess.
81.official: (Well, let's get her some food for now.)

82.literal: Alright, I bought some piping-hot takoyaki.
82.official: (Okay, got the takoyaki, nice and hot.)

83.literal: Now I gotta hurry back to the girl before it gets cold.
83.official: (Let's get it back to her before it gets cold.)

84.literal: Around here... there's probably one over by Hoganji Yokocho.
84.official: (I mighta seen one in the Hoganji Yokocho area, maybe? It's worth a check.)

85.literal: You makin' fun of us? ...Sure, we let our guard down last night.
85.official: The fuck do you think you are? You got us by surprise last night.

86.literal: We can't afford to care how it looks anymore.
86.official: At this point, we're done fightin' fair.

87.literal: ...H-how tough are you!? What the hell are you!?
87.official: The... The hell's this guy made of? Who ARE you!?

88.literal: Some kind of trouble? That's not like you.
88.official: Did you get mixed up in some kind of trouble? It's not like you to bust heads right on your own doorstep.

89.literal: Then where are you headed, leaving the club unattended?
89.official: Then where are you going? Not work, apparently.

90.literal: I hear you didn't go back to your roost.
90.official: And yet I hear you didn't go home last night.

91.literal: I ain't got time for idle chatter.
91.official: I don't got time to waste on chit-chat.

92.literal: I'd sooner go to a telephone pole.
92.official: I'd sooner ask a telephone pole than come to you with my problems.

93.literal: Lee's gotta be watching me from somewhere.
93.official: (Lee's gotta be watchin' from somewhere or other.)

94.literal: How's your injury been since then?
94.official: How you holdin' up, ya bear?

95.literal: Doing a job you've gotta throw yourself into like crazy.
95.official: Havin' yer balls to the wall.

96.literal: We're bein' hunted. No time to be feelin' pain.
96.official: We don't shake these yakuza now, they'll chase us to the grave. Ain't got time to be feelin' pain till this job's done.

97.official: Got at least four sets of eyes on it.

98.literal: Nah. This place has been under surveillance for a long time.
98.official: Nah. This place's been under watch for a long-ass time.

99.literal: So this whole town is your cage?
99.official: So what, this town's your prison cell?

101.literal: Let's change locations. We'll meet up where Makoto is.
101.official: Let's take this someplace safer. Meet you where Makoto's hidin'.

102.literal: I'll show you a good route.
102.official: Here, I'll show you a route where nobody can follow you.

103.literal: Yeah... At the back of the examination room in Hogushi Kaikan, there's a hidden door
103.official: See, I got a secret door in the back of the patient room at the clinic.

104.literal: Even if you're being tailed, if you use that hidden door
104.official: Even if you're bein' tailed, that passage should be enough to throw most anybody off.

105.literal: Why've you got a hidden door rigged up in your shop?
105.official: How come a massage clinic's got a secret escape route?

106.literal: Your face is known. No telling where they're watching from.
106.official: The boys who came for Makoto last night know your face. No tellin' where they could be watchin' from.

107.literal: Go to Makoto's place. You'll meet up with me there. Got it?
107.official: Once you're through that, head straight for Makoto. I'll meet ya there. Got it?

108.literal: (He said it leads through to the building next door...
108.official: (It's s'posed to connect to the building next door...)

109.literal: If I remember right, he said the hidden door was blocked by a shelf
109.official: (He said there was a bookshelf blockin' the door...)

110.literal: I not involved! I only come to get change of clothes for Lee-san!
110.official: I not involved! Just come to get clothes for Lee-san!

111.literal: A change of clothes for Lee?

112.official: That is where I see all my patients.

114.literal: How can you say that so definitively?
114.official: And how can you be sure of that?

115.literal: With no family and nowhere to go,
115.official: No people here, no place to go...

116.literal: Working as a live-in hostess and such,
116.official: She got gigs as a live-in hostess or whatever else.

117.literal: He sold her off. ...To a Korean organization.
117.official: That guy with the bat tattoo sold her off for cash. It was Korean mafia that bought her.

118.literal: That's the cause. From the stress of being pushed to the absolute limit,
118.official: But that's why she can't see now. Post-traumatic psychogenic blindness was the official diagnosis...

119.literal: In a darkness where the sun never even shone...
119.official: And from that gloomy cage they kept her in,

120.literal: It was the "bat tattoo" on that scumbag's arm.
120.official: the last thing she ever saw was the tattoo of a bat on the arm of the scumbag that sold her.

121.literal: ...So for the sake of revenge, you two
121.official: And you been searching for this guy with the bat tattoo to get revenge for her?

122.literal: have been hunting all over for the bat tattoo, huh?
122.official: And you been searching for this guy with the bat tattoo to get revenge for her?

123.literal: He's a small fry who does nothing bigger than snatch women.
123.official: The bat piece'a shit is small time, goes around town picking off innocent girls where he finds 'em, probably all by himself.

124.literal: But it's... a move that's like a powerful poison.
124.official: I'll warn you now, though... it ain't pretty.

126.literal: I'll tell you once I've got it figured out. Until then, it's a secret.
126.official: I'll tell you once I got it worked out. Till then, it stays secret.

127.literal: You went to the trouble of coming all the way out to a place like this.

128.literal: I always wanted to try playing mahjong with your breed, a hitman.
128.official: See, I always wanted to play a round of mahjong with a hitman.

129.literal: You're at the stage where you're digging in your heels so you don't cross the line.

131.literal: ...The yakuza who put bullet holes in your body.
131.official: Take the yakuza who put air holes in that body of yours, for instance.
